# KitchenLookup

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum KitchenLookup
```

Why [`Kitchen.TryFindIn()`](Nfty.Core.Formats.Kitchen.md#m-tryfindin-system-string) did or did not find a workspace.

## Values

- <span id="f-found"></span>`Found = 0` - Exactly one `.ktn`: the folder is a workspace.
- <span id="f-notaworkspace"></span>`NotAWorkspace = 1` - No `.ktn`, or no such folder — an ordinary directory, which is not an error.
- <span id="f-ambiguous"></span>`Ambiguous = 2` - More than one `.ktn`. Only the user can say which was meant, so this is reported rather than resolved by picking one.
